ios.desc:
Neuron AI Pro is the fastest, most private AI chat and productivity tool, optimized from the ground-up for Apple Silicon. Experience on-device AI processing with no internet required, ensuring 100% privacy.

With Neuron AI in your pocket, you can: 
* Enjoy up to three (3) AI chats with an unlimited number of messages
* Instantly summarize audio recordings in any language 
* Effortlessly search through all of your AI chats
* Easily integrate with the Shortcuts app for near limitless automations
* Share any message, summary or audio recording with a long-press by email, text, AirDrop, notes or other 3rd party apps
* Automatically adapt between light and dark mode
* Wish for new features for future versions
* Use it across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Vision Pro

Go Pro and get unlimited access to the full power of AI: 
* Enjoy unlimited AI chats
* Unlimited access to transcripts and summaries of audio recordings
* Choose from 45+ advanced AI models for smarter intelligence, superior responses, and faster transcriptions 
* Customize your AI’s system prompt
* Access the full transcripts of audio recordings
* AI-generated titles for your chats
* Personalize your AI experience in over 1000 ways: accent colors, custom fonts, haptic feedback, and more

Transform your productivity, streamline workflows, and keep all chats fully secure and private with Neuron AI.
